description: Installation of 18 non-illuminated PVC banners to existing lamppost columns on High Street, Brentford
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years

Condition : 2 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 4 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Lamppost banner specification sheet, Technical drawing, 7 page document showing (Specification sheet; Banner Specs; Bracket Specs; Bracket system for lamppost/ flag pole banners), Lighting assessment, CP Media supporting statement, Banner example.
Received: 28 September 2021
Unnumbered location plan Rev B
Received: 18 November 2021 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - Supporting Statement:
The hereby approved advert banners shall be managed in strict accordance with the submitted CP Media Supporting Statement received 28/09/2021 and in accordance with said statement each new sponsor's artwork shall first be agreed in writing by the Council prior to installation.

Condition : 7 - Height above footway:
The hereby approved advert banners shall be installed at least 2.6 meters above the ground level of the footway immediately below.
